description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe at Ghost Ranch holding a steer skull on her lap on the steps of her courtyard patio. Behind her are intersecting  portales, kiva ladder, and a view of the mountain above the roof line. She is wearing leather loafers, a black suit jacket over a white button-up collared shirt, and a white flowing head scarf under her signature black wide brim hat.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe, Ghost Ranch
